description: This file defines interfaces related to stream namespace predicates used for filtering implicit subscriptions within the Orleans Broadcast Channel framework. It includes interfaces for predicate logic and their providers, facilitating customizable subscription filtering.

classes.name: IChannelNamespacePredicate
classes.description: Interface for predicates used to determine if a subscription to a specific stream namespace is appropriate. Implements a method to check matching criteria and a property to get the predicate pattern.

classes.name: IChannelNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Interface for components that can instantiate <see cref="IChannelNamespacePredicate"/> objects based on pattern strings, enabling dynamic predicate creation.

methods.name: IsMatch
methods.description: Determines whether the given stream namespace matches the predicate criteria.

methods.name: PredicatePattern
methods.description: Property that provides a pattern string representing this predicate, used for serialization and recreation.

methods.name: TryGetPredicate
methods.description: Attempts to create a predicate instance from a provided pattern string; returns true if successful.
